column4: Deep satisfaction in focused mastery. Concentrated, recognized, productive.
Specialization chosen by external pressure. Inherited path, not elected.
Curiosity alive but constrained. External systems compress exploration.
Once explored widely, now consolidated. Broader curiosity lies dormant.
Start with intensity, abandon at difficulty. Fear of imperfection blocks progress.
Learn voraciously, create sparingly. Knowledge accumulates without direction.
Breadth is real but socially mediated. Skills driven by external utility.
Move between interests without depth or integration. Drift follows trends.
In motion. Patterns forming but not fixed. Becoming, not yet arrived.
Hold vision of skill connections. Actively weave into coherent systems.
Integration from necessity. Hard-won, pragmatic combination of skills.
Develop intensely, one at a time, each building on the last. Polymath in time.
